entries.name: TRINITY 1
entries.principle: The first hybrid system combining active gimbal stabilization with classical Steadicam mechanics. Enables continuous camera movement from any position — floor to overhead — without setup changes.

entries.name: TRINITY 2
entries.principle: Next-generation successor with reduced weight, expanded stabilization modes, and refined operating logic. Concept, design, and development by Curt O. Schaller in cooperation with ARRI.
